candidates.change_summary: Remove checks for IERC1155 and IERC1155MetadataURI interface IDs so supportsInterface returns false for those IDs while still returning true for IERC165.
Replace the IERC1155 interface ID check with a different, invalid interface ID so that calls with the legitimate IERC1155 ID return false instead of true.
Replace the IERC1155MetadataURI interface ID check with a different, invalid interface ID so that calls with the legitimate IERC1155MetadataURI ID return false instead of true.
Replace the whole return expression with false to make all supported interface queries return false, including type(IERC165).interfaceId.
Remove the require that account != address(0), allowing zero-address lookup that returns different (non-reverting) values.
Delete the entire balance-check logic and always return 0, changing a positive balance call to return 0.
Return the balance of a fixed different id (id+1) instead of the requested id, altering the returned amount.
Remove the require statement that checks account != address(0), allowing balanceOf to be called on the zero address and return a non-zero value for tokens held by the zero address.
Replace the account != address(0) check with account == address(0), reverting for all non-zero addresses but returning balance for the zero address.
Replace the entire function body to always return 0, changing the balance returned for any account that holds tokens.
Return balance from a different token id by adding 1 to the id parameter, returning the balance of token id+1 instead.
Delete the require statement, allowing zero-address balances to be queried, which changes the return value for mints/burns to address(0).
